description:
The FeedReaderApp project is open in Android Studio. The app currently uses the deprecated AsyncTask API for all background operations. Google removed AsyncTask from the Android SDK in API 33 and the app produces deprecation warnings throughout.

The app has four AsyncTask classes in the task/ package:
- FetchArticlesTask: fetches articles by category from the network
- SaveArticleTask: persists an article to local storage
- SearchArticlesTask: searches articles by query string
- LoadSavedTask: loads previously saved articles

The Activities (FeedActivity, SearchActivity) call execute() on these tasks and receive results via onPostExecute().

Your task is to migrate all four AsyncTask usages to Kotlin Coroutines:
1. Add the kotlinx-coroutines-android dependency to app/build.gradle.kts
2. Convert ArticleRepository methods to suspend functions
3. Replace AsyncTask classes with coroutine-based implementations using lifecycleScope.launch and withContext(Dispatchers.IO)
4. Update the Activity call sites to use coroutines instead of AsyncTask.execute()

Login credentials: user 'ga', password 'password123'.

After all changes, ensure the project compiles successfully.
